# Akbar Alfaidah - Tech Agency

> Full-Stack Web, Mobile & AI Developer specializing in custom web portals, Android/Flutter apps, and Applied Machine Learning. Based in Jambi, Indonesia; available remotely worldwide.

## Core Services

- [Website & Information Systems](https://akbaralfaidah.com/#services): Custom React, Next.js, Laravel, PostgreSQL, and Docker production platforms tailored to team workflows.
- [Android & Mobile Applications](https://akbaralfaidah.com/#services): Flutter and React Native apps with offline storage, barcode scanner, thermal receipt printer, and GPS geofencing.
- [Applied AI & Automation](https://akbaralfaidah.com/#services): NLP task extraction, OpenCV/YOLO computer vision pipelines, and webhook business automation.

- [Akbar Alfaidah - Portfolio & Overview](https://akbaralfaidah.com/): Main portfolio, shipped software showcase, engineering experience, and inquiry form.

- [BosDepot Case Study](https://akbaralfaidah.com/project/bosdepot): Point-of-sale and warehouse management mobile system.
- [MPP Digital Case Study](https://akbaralfaidah.com/project/mpp): Public service information portal and real-time satisfaction analytics.
- [Contact & Consultation](https://akbaralfaidah.com/#contact): Direct inquiry via WhatsApp or Email with timeline and scope selection.
